_online2Description: Welcome! In this experiment you will see some letters and respond to them. This experiment requires a computer with at least 6 cores.
instructionForBlock:
In this session, you will perform tasks on the computer.
In each task, when you answer correctly, you will hear a beep. Click on the "BEEP" button to make sure the computer's audio is on.

In this block, you must keep your cursor at the center of a black cross until a letter appears. While your cursor is at the center of the cross, please keep your eyes on the cross as well. The letter will appear away from the cross, in the corner of your eye. It will flash quickly. After the letter disappear, you will report the letter you see. Note that the letter ALWAYS APPEAR ON THE RIGHT of the cross. The size of the letter can vary greatly from trial to trial. In some trials, the letter might be very small. Please try your best to keep your eyes on the cross at the center and view the letter with your side vision.

Click on PROCEED to continue.

In this block, you will need to keep the cursor at the center of a black cross until THREE letters appear, for example: Z R N. The letters will appear away from the cross, in the corner of your eye. IN THIS BLOCK, THE LETTERS ALWAYS APPEAR ON THE RIGHT of the crosshair. The size of the letters and the spacing between the letters can vary greatly from trial to trial. In some trials, the letters might be very small. Please try your best to keep your eyes on the cross at the center and view the letters with your side vision.

Click on PROCEED to continue.

instructionForBlock:
In this block, you will use your cursor to track the center of a moving black cross until three letters appear, for example: Z R N. The letters will appear away from the cross (on the RIGHT of the cross), in the corner of your eye. They will flash quickly.
